brief.goal: Replace the old-project daily token keepalive with a v2-local daily OAuth refresh that writes only the ignored local credential file.
brief.document_instruction_boundary: This task does not authorize business platform APIs or disclosure of credentials.

allowed_actions: Update v2 .local/oceanengine.env only through credential store
Create/activate v2 local cron and delete the named legacy cron after a passed v2 validation
forbidden_actions: Project, promotion, material, DMP, or event-asset writes
Deleting the legacy cron before v2 refresh validation passes
